spans.label: serde Serialize/Deserialize import
spans.note: Derived serde encoding of BitPath is an imported interface; the model says nothing about it.

spans.label: doc comments, blank lines and the derive attribute
spans.note: No executable constraint is inferred from comments or derives.

spans.label: BitPath fields (length, value) and BitPath::new
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics; BitPath::new does not mask value, which index_bits_ignore_high_bits records. No source refinement.

spans.label: is_empty, len and value accessors
spans.note: Handwritten local semantics of the three accessors; no source refinement.

spans.label: pop: low bit first, then shift right and shorten
spans.note: Pins the LITTLE-ENDIAN, leaf-to-root bit order of the decomposition; no source refinement.

spans.label: sibling: flip the low bit
spans.note: `^= 1` on an unbounded Nat is modelled as flipLowBit; u64 wrap-around is not modelled.

boundaries.name: poseidon-hash-callback
boundaries.obligation: Leafable::hash and LeafableHasher::two_to_one are opaque callbacks (HashEnv). Nothing here establishes collision resistance, preimage resistance, or any algebraic property of Poseidon/Keccak, nor that leaf and node hashing are domain separated (they are not).

boundaries.name: collision-freedom-premise
boundaries.obligation: NoCollisionAlong and LeafHashInjectiveOn are explicit, undischarged premises about the specific compared pairs. They are NOT global hash injectivity and are not proved for the real hash.

boundaries.name: native-target-refinement
boundaries.obligation: The Lean definitions are a handwritten local semantics. No refinement of the Rust source, of rustc codegen, or of the plonky2-compiled circuit is proved.

boundaries.name: rust-integer-widths
boundaries.obligation: BitPath.length (u32), BitPath.value (u64) and usize heights/lengths are modelled as unbounded Nat. Wrap-around of `>>=`/`^=`, `1 << height` overflow on 32-bit targets, and usize truncation are not modelled.

boundaries.name: root-provenance
boundaries.obligation: A verified opening says only that the recomputed root equals the supplied root. Nothing here establishes that the root is canonical, current, on-chain, or produced by an honest tree.

boundaries.name: serde-roundtrip
boundaries.obligation: The derived Serialize/Deserialize instances for BitPath are not modelled; a decoded BitPath is assumed well formed.
